fact: The Health Care Agency signed a contract with India-based Manorama Infosolutions in December 2019 for the electronic health system, its software funded by an Indian government line of credit of about $4 million; reception areas in all government hospitals and clinics went on the system in March 2021 and doctors in the clinics began entering electronic medical records in October 2022, with some doctors still using handwritten notes as of June 2023.
title: Seychelles: Digitisation of Seychelles’ Public Health System Nearly Complete
